---
title: "Future post"
description: "A post with a publication date (prefix of the name of the file) far in the future, used to check that it is not considered published until that date."
tags: ["demo"]
---
A test post with the date `2099-01-01`, used to check that a content with a
future `date` is not treated as "published" (it should not be listed, nor be
accessible outside a local environment) before that date arrives.
